observations.event_counts: Both cases report input, accepted, unique, collapsed duplicate, and ignored counts.
observations.dedupe: Duplicate source URL plus normalized title is collapsed while all source event IDs, timestamps, and links are retained.
observations.source_mapping: Every digest item has a source_map entry with event IDs, timestamps, and links.
observations.blocker_criteria: Default blocker statuses are blocked, failed, and failing; default blocker labels are blocker and blocked.
observations.receipt: Both harness receipts are sealed and independently signature-verifiable.
